title: Vendors counts follow the same rules as customers
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 45 is held by {Count-A} vendors (written down). Vendor {Vendor-A} is stored with "NET 45" and vendor {Vendor-B} holds Net 45 and is inactive; both are in {Count-A}.
    For example: {Count-A} is 5, {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-22 Upper and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-22 Inactive.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the Net 45 row's Vendors cell.
  2. Open Edit Vendor for {Vendor-A}.
  3. Choose "Net 60".
  4. Click Save & Close.
  5. Reload the Credit Terms page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: it reads {Count-A} (for example 5): "NET 45" counts as Net 45 and the inactive vendor counts.
  • Step 2: the window opens.
  • Step 3: the dropdown shows Net 60.
  • Step 4: the window closes and the vendor is saved on Net 60.
  • Step 5: Net 45 reads {Count-A} − 1 (for example 4) and Net 60's Vendors count went up by 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S1-R13: “The Vendors column shows how many vendors hold the term, right aligned, 0 when none, by the same rules as S1-R12 (a blank vendor term counts under COD).”
  • S6-E2: “Vendors on a term count toward its "in use" lock (Story 2: Row menu actions) and its Vendors column (Story 1: Credit Terms page and list).”
  • Terminology: “In use → A term is in use when at least one customer, vendor or invoice (work order or part sale invoice) holds it. Vendor invoices, deliveries and vendor credits store no term, so they never count. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer or vendor with a blank term counts as COD. Every invoice ever created counts, including reversed and paid ones; estimates never count. Customers and vendors count and are listed whatever their status.”
